payload.title: The stack-plan dry run cannot describe the procedure-runner stack: the plan role lacks cloudformation:DescribeStacks
payload.description: Every Papyrus PR's dry-run (stack-deploy) fails: the papyrus-stack-plan-github role (the production account) is not authorized to perform cloudformation:DescribeStacks on the papyrus-procedure-runner stack, because no identity-based policy allows it. The stack came with the runner-in-pipeline change (947bca90d). The plan role needs read-only DescribeStacks on that stack; roles change only through the role-stack-deploy workflow after a person approves it, so nothing was widened by an agent. Effect: no PR shows a plan, so a release that adds the EntityLabel table and the entity-label-sync consumer has no CI plan to read; the diff was read from a local synth instead.
